attributes.name: Incendiary Cloud
attributes.powers: Display this card when a character encounters a monster. While displayed, add 2d4 and the Fire trait to combat checks to defeat monsters. At the end of the turn, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at an Arcane 10 check to recharge it instead.
